fields.climate: Mediterranean with mild winters and warm summers
fields.terrain: a narrow coastal lowland borders the Rock of Gibraltar
fields.hazards: occasional droughts; no streams or large bodies of water on the peninsula (all potable water comes from desalination)
fields.exports: refined petroleum, natural gas, ships, cars, scrap iron
fields.industries: tourism, banking and finance, ship repairing, tobacco
fields.languages: English (used in schools and for official purposes), Spanish, Italian, Portuguese
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 72.1%, Church of England 7.7%, other Christian 3.8%, Muslim 3.6%, Jewish 2.4%, Hindu 2%, other 1.1%, none 7.1%, unspecified 0.1%

system.text: parliamentary democracy (Parliament); self-governing overseas territory of the UK

fields.legal: the laws of the UK apply
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal; and British citizens with six months residence or more
